introHtml: Comfort Colors sweaters and cardigans offer a lived-in softness right out of the box, making them a favorite for employee gifts, team uniforms, and retail merchandise. The garment-dyed process gives each piece a unique vintage look that stands out from standard fleece. With a wide range of earth-toned colors and a relaxed fit, these custom sweaters and cardigans are ideal for companies that want a comfortable, laid-back aesthetic. Decorate with embroidery or screen printing for a polished, lasting impression.
